ny-aurora-erie-county-2025.date_enacted: 2025-05-27, filed with the NYS Department of State 2025-06-09
ny-aurora-erie-county-2025.duration: Six months, extended by resolution for additional six-month periods
ny-aurora-erie-county-2025.legal_basis: Town of Aurora Local Law 5-2025, a six-month moratorium on new applications for battery energy storage systems
ny-aurora-erie-county-2025.trigger: Time needed to complete the town's Comprehensive Plan and a BESS-specific local law
ny-aurora-erie-county-2025.current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23. Extended by unanimous Town Board resolution on 2025-12-22, effective 2025-12-09 through 2026-06-09, to allow the Comprehensive Plan and a BESS local law to be completed.

ny-babylon-2024.duration: Six months, repeatedly extended by resolution (Local Law 23 of 2024 on 2024-12-04; Local Law 8 of 2025 on 2025-07-09; Local Law 2 of 2026 on 2026-01-05)
ny-babylon-2024.legal_basis: Town of Babylon 2026 Moratorium Law on Battery Energy Storage System Facilities (Local Law No. 2 of 2026, extending Local Law 11 of 2024)
ny-babylon-2024.trigger: BESS fires elsewhere in New York; Fire Marshal and Department of Environmental Control concerns about environmentally sensitive watersheds, the Great South Bay, and Special Groundwater Protection Areas
ny-babylon-2024.current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23. Most recently extended by Local Law No. 2 of 2026, adopted January 5, 2026 following a December 17, 2025 public hearing, for six more months.
ny-babylon-2024.outcome: Adopted 2024-06-05, extended at least three times

ny-bedford-2024.duration: Six months, repeatedly extended by resolution (Local Law No. 1-2025 effective ~2025-02-16; further extensions through at least September 2026)
ny-bedford-2024.legal_basis: Town of Bedford local law prohibiting review and approval of applications for battery energy storage systems (Local Law No. 1-2025 extending the original 2024-08-13 moratorium)
ny-bedford-2024.trigger: BESS fires elsewhere in New York; a Bedford advisory committee developing a model ordinance with NYSERDA and Westchester Business Council input
ny-bedford-2024.current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23. A committee is finalizing a model BESS ordinance; the Town Board approved a further six-month extension in an uncontested hearing (no public comment), and a September 8, 2026 public hearing notice indicates the town continued to extend the moratorium into the fall of 2026.

ny-berne-2025.date_enacted: 2025-05-06 (second Berne solar moratorium; the first was 2019)
ny-berne-2025.duration: Originally twelve months; March 11, 2026 Resolution No. 35 extended it through November 6, 2026. A further six-month extension was proposed in September 2026; adoption and filing have not been verified.
ny-berne-2025.legal_basis: Town of Berne Local Law No. 1 of 2025, covering solar energy and battery energy storage systems, extended by Resolution No. 35 of 2026.
ny-berne-2025.trigger: A proposed 4.25 MW TJA Energy solar facility and a proposed 3.8 MW RIC Energy solar facility
ny-berne-2025.current_status: May 6, 2025 minutes adopt Local Law 1 of 2025 with solar and BESS scope. September 2026 minutes describe the March Resolution 35 extension through November 6 and a proposed further extension; October 14 draft minutes record a hearing. The claimed September further adoption, filing and later force are not established. [VERIFY: operative interval, later amendments/extensions/repeal, judicial developments and current legal force.]
ny-berne-2025.affected_projects: TJA Energy's 4.25 MW solar proposal (Switzkill/Canaday Hill Roads); RIC Energy's 3.8 MW solar proposal (28 Jansen Lane)
ny-berne-2025.outcome: Adopted and extended; a further extension was proposed in 2026.
